subject.title: fix(pdf): reject unsafe page numbers before analysis

question: After the hanging-test repair, should any unsafe integer token reject the entire PDF page selection, including mixed selections with otherwise valid pages?
rationale: The guard fixes ambiguous numeric parsing, but it deliberately replaces current partial acceptance of malformed mixed input with fail-closed rejection.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Reject the full selection before PDF loading whenever any token is outside the safe positive integer domain.

options.title: Preserve partial acceptance
options.body: Continue processing valid pages while silently omitting unsafe tokens that exceed the configured maximum.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Reject the full selection before PDF loading whenever any token is outside the safe positive integer domain.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across these files and merged the immediately adjacent fractional-page hardening.
